title: Building Concise Logical Patterns by Constraining Tsetlin Machine Clause Size
new_feature: Clause Size Constrained TM (CSC-TM): a soft literal budget b on clause size; once a clause exceeds b literals, Type I feedback only reinforces Exclude, so oversized clauses expel literals. Includes convergence analysis for XOR/OR and a hardware switching-activity argument.

datasets.notes: Hendrickx et al. 2009 (SemEval-2010 Task 8); number of classes as used not stated
two-class variant of CIFAR-10 grouping vehicle vs animal images
used with vanilla and convolutional TM
